sql: SELECT T2.CODE FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.ITEM = T2.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY T1.OCCURRENCES DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(e.ID) FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON e.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Major' AND p.last = 'D''Amore'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Keven' AND p.last = 'Kuhn' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'DTaP'

SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE m.DESCRIPTION = 'Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y', m.STOP) - strftime('%Y', m.START) > 10
SELECT T2."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM conditions T1 JOIN all_prevalences T2 ON lower(T1.DESCRIPTION) = lower(T2.ITEM) WHERE T1.START = '2014-05-09'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(i.PATIENT), SUM(CASE WHEN i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' AND p.ethnicity = 'english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE strftime('%Y', i.DATE) = '2017'
SELECT DISTINCT p.birthdate FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Outpatient Encounter'
SELECT DISTINCT p.last FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON a.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE a.DESCRIPTION = 'Allergy to dairy product'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE i.DESCRIPTION = 'HPV  quadrivalent' AND p.gender = 'F'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE m.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Coronary Heart Disease' AND m.STOP IS NOT NULL AND p.deathdate IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT c.BILLABLEPERIOD FROM claims c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.last = 'Dickinson'
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Otitis media'
SELECT COUNT(c.PATIENT) FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND c.START BETWEEN '2009-11-1' AND '2010-10-23'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.PATIENT) FROM encounters e JOIN immunizations i ON e.PATIENT = i.PATIENT WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy' AND e.DATE = i.DATE

SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION, pr.DESCRIPTION, m.DESCRIPTION, p.first, p.last FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON e.PATIENT = p.patient LEFT JOIN careplans c ON c.ENCOUNTER = e.ID LEFT JOIN procedures pr ON pr.ENCOUNTER = e.ID LEFT JOIN medications m ON m.ENCOUNTER = e.ID WHERE e.ID = '6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.PATIENT ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.PATIENT ELSE NULL END) FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Glucose'
SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND p.first = 'Joye' AND p.last = 'Homenick' AND substr(c.START, 1, 4) = '2017'

SELECT MAX(i.DATE) FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND p.first = 'Joye' AND p.last = 'Homenick' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
